responsibility: Declares the entry point for GCC’s tree-level loop if-conversion transformation. It exposes the tree_if_conversion routine used by loop/vectorization infrastructure to attempt predication and block merging on a candidate loop, optionally collecting helper GIMPLE markers for later processing.
same_name_distinction: Provides only the exported entry point for loop if-conversion. Unlike gcc/tree-if-conv.cc, it does not contain the conversion pass logic, profitability/versioning handling, or CFG/SSA rewrite implementation.
